bio: As the saying goes, the nose knows. These are words to live by at this vibrant Argentinian parilla. With big meats sizzling over a roaring grill, a subtle smoke wafts through the long dining room, built out of sleek wood, exposed brick and dangling greenery. When the nights are cool, the party is further back out on the well-tended patio. Everything here is meant to be shared, starting with the hearty empanadas that come stuffed with everything from filet mignon and raisins to pork shoulder and potatoes. Housemade pastas and chicken milanesa are always tempting, but first timers should dig into favorites like skirt steak with chimichurri. Only serious appetites should order the combination platter featuring steak, ribs, chorizo and sweetbreads....
